article.title: Trump readies 40,000 bombs for Israel, wider war after Nov. 3
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The White House is drafting plans for West Asia after the present stage of the war. They center on containing Iran and pushing more Arab governments into formal relations with Israel.
